summary: Iteration 5 validated the full feature surface area: (a) 2 new locations pfaeffikon-sz + richterswil (now 11 total); (b) hero H1 exact = 'Fahrschule {name}' with pill badge below; (c) Google Reviews integration on home (Testimonials reviews-google-cta target=_blank + per-card Google badge) and on every location page (loc-google-reviews + loc-google-reviews-cta target=_blank); (d) consistent SiteHeader across /, /ablauf, /vku, /fahrschule-* with all 7 nav-* testids; (e) new loc-why-saferide section with 6 why_points2 bullets and dark bg; (f) 15 FAQs per location (migrated from 4); (g) /api/sitemap.xml with 14 URLs using public base URL; (h) editable per-location google_reviews_url via loc-google-reviews-url input. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py with 21 new tests, ALL 21 PASS. Combined suite 66/68 (the 2 remaining failures are the same pre-existing flaky races already noted in iteration_4 — TestAdminSubmissions::test_list_and_lifecycle and test_patch_content::test_patch_top_level_dot_path_and_revert race against each other when run with pytest-xdist). Frontend: verified via Playwright on real URL. /fahrschule-einsiedeln H1 textContent EXACTLY 'Fahrschule Einsiedeln' (no italic highlight inside H1); pill 'Klosterdorf · Übungsstrecken zwischen Berg & Tal' rendered with rounded-full class below H1. site-header on sub-pages opaque (rgba(251,249,246,0.9)). All 7 nav-* testids present on /, /ablauf, /vku, /fahrschule-einsiedeln. Clicking nav-pricing on /ablauf navigates to /#pricing AND scrolls pricing section to top of viewport (top=0.34px). loc-why-saferide with all 6 [data-testid=loc-why2-0..5] points rendered. loc-google-reviews + loc-google-reviews-cta href=https://www.google.com/search?q=...Safe+Ride+Nadine... target=_blank. Exactly 15 numeric loc-faq-* items on einsiedeln, pfaeffikon-sz and richterswil. Home reviews-google-cta href + target=_blank verified. Two new slugs render H1='Fahrschule Pfäffikon SZ' / 'Fahrschule Richterswil' with why=1, google_reviews=1, faqs=15. Admin pages tab shows all 11 pages-link-loc-* including pfaeffikon-sz and richterswil. Edit mode on /fahrschule-einsiedeln: total 76 [data-edit-path] wrappers; all 10 spec'd paths present exactly once (hero_title_de, why_title2_de, why_body2_de, why_points2.0.text_de, google_reviews_title_de, google_reviews_cta_de, google_reviews_subtitle_de, faq_intro_de, faqs.0.question_de, faqs.14.question_de). loc-google-reviews-url input visible ONLY in edit mode (1 in edit, 0 in preview). Unknown slug /fahrschule-foo renders in-page 404 'Standort nicht gefunden' without redirect. PATCH /api/locations/einsiedeln with {why_title2_de, google_reviews_url} updates only those fields, persists via GET, and reverts cleanly — verified end-to-end in pytest.
